newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET TO RISE 9.9 PCT, STAY BALANCED IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET TO RISE 9.9 PCT, STAY BALANCED IN 1998.

text.p: Finance Minister Robert Zile on Tuesday said that the cabinet is working on a draft for the 1998 state budget which will see the total budget amount rise by 9.9 percent but will again have a balance of spending and revenue.

"The cabinet is expected today to agree on the draft 1998 budget determining a rough outline of expenditure and income targets for ministries, envisaging a balanced budget," Zile told a news conference.
"We expect the total budget to grow by some 9.9 percent," he added. Zile today marks 100 days as finance minister.
The draft also envisages a 50 percent increase in state investment, in line with the government programme, Zile said.
The ministry earlier said the final version of the state budget for 1998-99 should be ready by September.
He also said that the finance ministry had drawn up a law to combine income and corporate tax in one package which brings the country closer to a first level of EU norms.
But he said that Latvia had still to work on excise tax and would consult first of all with Lithuania and Estonia to have more regional balance.
